answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. A seat is earned, not claimed: Brinebound salt field keeper pan charter makes sure of that, since a charter salt field keepers file after salt field checks. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A farm faces £18 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. lantern is written on the receipt. ledge stays on the record. Every inlet is counted once.
